What is D-Squad's Maxillipede shuttle?

A Maxillipede shuttle was used by D-Squad to carry out a mission to steal an encryption module from a Providence-class Dreadnought commanded by the super tactical droid Aut-O. After the module had been stolen and the squad had departed,
